findings.title: "copies ItemSettingsMapping.ToGoTo/GoToLabel verbatim" overstates it; the editor's "Do nothing" label has no counterpart in the real mapping, and ItemSettingsMapping is internal to the Presenter assembly so a Core helper must re-implement rather than call it
findings.where: Gap #1 label table caption; Auto-advance mapping "When complete ⇄ AutoAdvanceGoTo"; Summary of decisions
findings.fix: Replace the "verbatim copy" claim with: mirrors ItemSettingsMapping's enum targets but uses this editor's sentence-case labels and adds an explicit 'Do nothing' option mapped to the model default NextSlide (the original folds NextSlide into 'Next Item'); the mapping is re-implemented in the Core SlideAutoAdvanceMap helper because ItemSettingsMapping is internal to the Presenter assembly.

findings.title: "Do nothing" + "Go to next slide after = Time Delay" is reachable and the resolver advances to next item (NextSlide branch), contradicting the label; design does not state the expected outcome
findings.where: Gap #1 label table "Do nothing" row; Auto-advance mapping "What is written on save"
findings.fix: Add one sentence: under a real trigger, 'Do nothing' stores NextSlide, which the resolver treats as advance-to-next-item; state this is intended ('Do nothing' = no special end-of-item destination, fall through to natural next item), matching the existing panel's NextSlide/NextItem fold; a true 'stay put' is Loop.
